cohort: 1041 Obstetrics and Gynecology trainees in Italy
finding: Needlestick injuries are frequent among Obstetrics and Gynecology trainees, particularly during obstetric surgery, but are often not reported.
mod_finding: The most recent needlestick injury was experienced during cesarean section in 57.1% of cases, primarily inflicted by someone else (72.4%), while 42.9% occurred during perineal suture, with 84% being self-inflicted.
